3D Scatter Plots

Source: vignettes/articles/r-docs/3d-scatter-plots.Rmd
3d-scatter-plots.Rmd

Basic 3D Scatter Plot 

library(plotly.core)

mtcars$am[which(mtcars$am == 0)] <- 'Automatic'
mtcars$am[which(mtcars$am == 1)] <- 'Manual'
mtcars$am <- as.factor(mtcars$am)

am_colors <- c(Automatic = "#BF382A", Manual = "#0C4B8E")

fig <- go_figure()
for (am in levels(mtcars$am)) {
  fig <- fig |>
    add_scatter3d(
      data = mtcars[mtcars$am == am, ],
      x = ~wt,
      y = ~hp,
      z = ~qsec,
      mode = "markers",
      name = am,
      marker = go_scatter3d_marker(color = am_colors[[am]])
    )
}
fig <- fig |>
  update_layout(
    scene = go_scene(
      xaxis = go_scene_axis(title = "Weight"),
      yaxis = go_scene_axis(title = "Gross horsepower"),
      zaxis = go_scene_axis(title = "1/4 mile time")
    )
  )

fig

3D Scatter Plot with Color Scaling 

library(plotly.core)

fig <- mtcars |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_scatter3d(
    x = ~wt,
    y = ~hp,
    z = ~qsec,
    mode = "markers",
    marker = go_scatter3d_marker(
      color = ~mpg,
      colorscale = c("#FFE1A1", "#683531"),
      showscale = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    scene = go_scene(
      xaxis = go_scene_axis(title = "Weight"),
      yaxis = go_scene_axis(title = "Gross horsepower"),
      zaxis = go_scene_axis(title = "1/4 mile time")
    )
  ) |>
  add_annotation(
    x = 1.13,
    y = 1.05,
    text = "Miles/(US) gallon",
    xref = "paper",
    yref = "paper",
    showarrow = FALSE
  )

fig

3D Bubble Plot 

library(plotly.core)

data <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plotly/datasets/master/gapminderDataFiveYear.csv")

data_2007 <- data[which(data$year == 2007),]
data_2007 <- data_2007[order(data_2007$continent, data_2007$country),]
# scale population to marker diameters between 5 and 150 pixels
data_2007$size <- scales::rescale(data_2007$pop, to = c(5, 150))
colors <- c('#4AC6B7', '#1972A4', '#965F8A', '#FF7070', '#C61951')
names(colors) <- sort(unique(data_2007$continent))

fig <- go_figure()
for (continent in names(colors)) {
  fig <- fig |>
    add_scatter3d(
      data = data_2007[data_2007$continent == continent, ],
      x = ~gdpPercap,
      y = ~lifeExp,
      z = ~pop,
      mode = "markers",
      name = continent,
      marker = go_scatter3d_marker(
        color = colors[[continent]],
        size = ~size,
        symbol = "circle",
        sizemode = "diameter"
      ),
      text = ~paste("Country:", country, "<br>Life Expectancy:", lifeExp,
                    "<br>GDP:", gdpPercap, "<br>Pop.:", pop)
    )
}
fig <- fig |>
  update_layout(
    title = "Life Expectancy v. Per Capita GDP, 2007",
    scene = go_scene(
      xaxis = go_scene_axis(
        title = "GDP per capita (2000 dollars)",
        gridcolor = "rgb(255, 255, 255)",
        range = c(2.003297660701705, 5.191505530708712),
        type = "log",
        zerolinewidth = 1,
        ticklen = 5,
        gridwidth = 2
      ),
      yaxis = go_scene_axis(
        title = "Life Expectancy (years)",
        gridcolor = "rgb(255, 255, 255)",
        range = c(36.12621671352166, 91.72921793264332),
        zerolinewidth = 1,
        ticklen = 5,
        gridwidth = 2
      ),
      zaxis = go_scene_axis(
        title = "Population",
        gridcolor = "rgb(255, 255, 255)",
        type = "log",
        zerolinewidth = 1,
        ticklen = 5,
        gridwidth = 2
      )
    ),
    paper_bgcolor = "rgb(243, 243, 243)",
    plot_bgcolor = "rgb(243, 243, 243)"
  )

fig
